newsitem.title: CHINA: Grand Met's IDV opens China venture.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met's IDV opens China venture.

text.p: International Distillers and Vintners (IDV), the drinks business arm of Grand Metropolitan PLC, has formally opened a $27 million distillery joint venture in China, company officials said on Tuesday.
Qufu Shengying International Distillers Ltd, which was launched in March 1996 and started production last November, formally opened on Monday, said Grand Metropolitan Chairman George Bull.
IDV has a 67 percent stake in the venture, with the remainder held by state-owned Qufu Distillery, a member of the Kong Fu Jia Group.
The venture was currently producing IDV brands including Old Gold Whisky, Grande Reserve VSOP and Smirnoff vodka, officials said.
